context: Ryosuke offers advice about retirement support to Kenji.

lines.speaker: ryosuke_dad
lines.jp: 健次さん、本当、頑張ってる、ね。
lines.en: Kenji-san, you really are working hard at this.
lines.style: Soft, genuine opening. Warm admiration threaded through the delivery. Voice settles into the compliment—not overstated, just real. The kind of thing said between people who respect each other.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: 亮介さんの、支援、本当、感謝。
lines.en: Ryosuke-san's support has meant so much. I'm truly grateful.
lines.style: Formal respect layered under genuine warmth. Steady voice, no stumbling—he's chosen his words. A small pause before 'grateful' lets the weight land. Not effusive, but sincere.

lines.speaker: ryosuke_dad
lines.en: Please, come talk to me anytime. I mean it.
lines.style: The words open with gentle insistence. 'Anytime' lands with quiet conviction—no hesitation. The tone is an invitation, not an obligation. Warm and solid.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: 一緒に、ここまで、来た、宝。
lines.en: Coming this far together—that's been a real treasure.
lines.style: Quiet, reflective. The realization settles as he speaks it. Slow enough to feel the meaning. Not sentimental, but genuine—the voice of someone who doesn't often say such things and means every word.

lines.speaker: ryosuke_dad
lines.en: This meeting, this friendship—it's precious. Truly.
lines.style: The opening is gentle, almost wondering. Voice carries weight without strain. 'Precious' lands softly but decisively. A man speaking from something deeper than everyday talk.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.en: And from now on, let's keep going. Really.
lines.style: Forward-looking warmth. 'From now on' opens with quiet promise. A steady, unhurried pace. The 'really' at the end isn't emphasis—it's a soft seal on what matters.

lines.speaker: ryosuke_dad
lines.jp: 感謝、こちらこそ、本当に。
lines.style: A gentle correction wrapped in affection. Voice is even, warm, final—not defensive, just clear. The kind of thing you say when you mean it more than the other person thinks you do.
